answer: An inlet admits prepaid service requests, never key-based subsidies. Each buyer's vault holds the exact payout; a bridge receipt consumes one request ID after verified delivery. Proposed validators audit duplicate IDs and burn a fee on every request. The farm's cheapest counter is to reuse one generator and self-buy work: it recovers only its own deposit minus the fee. Each profitable clone needs a distinct outside-funded order; loans cannot create outside demand and still incur the burned fee. If no buyer pays or a receipt is replayed, that key earns zero.
